baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Champ air purifier. A cylindrical home air purifier with a 3-in-1 filter, a motor and fan, control and power boards, a particle sensor and a moulded plastic housing. The Champ air purifier is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from Vietnam and China.

The motor, main key module and power module printed board assemblies and filter assembly are produced in Vietnam. The particle sensor, power cord assembly and wire harnesses are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Vietnam: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

key_factors: Motor, filter assembly, and main/power PCBAs
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of key components (motor, PCBAs, filter) and final assembly in Vietnam
prediction.reasoning: In Vietnam, the critical components imparting the essential character of the air purifier—specifically the motor, filter assembly, and main/power PCBAs—are manufactured, and all components are assembled into the finished appliance. The Chinese components (sensor, power cord, wire harnesses) are ancillary and undergo a substantial transformation when integrated with the Vietnamese subassemblies during final assembly in Vietnam, consistent with CBP precedent in H323218 and N359250.

The merchandise under consideration is a Champ air purifier. A cylindrical home air purifier with a 3-in-1 filter, a motor and fan, control and power boards, a particle sensor and a moulded plastic housing. The Champ air purifier is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from China.

The motor, main key module and power module printed board assemblies, filter assembly and particle sensor, power cord assembly and wire harnesses are produced in China. 

In China, the motor and filter assembly will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

In China, the main key module and power module printed board assemblies will be produced in-house: SMT placement and reflow of the printed circuit board assembly; test the PCBA (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

In China, the housing moulding will be produced in-house: injection-mould the plastic housing parts.

Final assembly in Vietnam: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

key_factors: Motor, fan, filter assembly, and printed circuit board assemblies
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the motor, PCBAs, filter, and housing in China
prediction.reasoning: Unlike N359250, N359251, and H323218 where the assembly country contributed substantial domestic components or subassembly manufacturing, here virtually all components—including the critical motor, fan, 3-in-1 filter, PCBAs, particle sensor, and molded housing—are wholly manufactured in China. The core manufacturing (motor winding/stamping, SMT reflow, and injection molding) occurs in China. The operations in Vietnam consist of simple pre-assembly and final installation of pre-made Chinese components, which does not rise to the level of a substantial transformation.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, core components (motor, main/power PCBAs, and filter assembly) are manufactured in Vietnam alongside final assembly, conferring Vietnam origin. In Variant B, ALL components—including the motor, fan, PCBAs (via SMT), filter assembly, sensor, and injection-molded plastic housing—are manufactured in China, leaving only simple sub-assembly, installation, testing, and packing in Vietnam. Unlike H323218 and N359251 (where plastic housing molding and fans/parts were produced in the assembly country), Variant B retains zero component fabrication in Vietnam. Under CBP precedent (e.g., N359672), assembling pre-made Chinese components without local component fabrication does not substantially transform the air purifier.
